network.title: We can't reach Vireek
network.body: Check your connection and try again. Nothing you've done is lost.

auth.title: You've been signed out
auth.body: For your security your session ended. Sign in again and pick up where you left off.

permission.title: You don't have access to this
permission.body: Your role doesn't allow this action. Ask your account owner to grant access, or contact support.

validation.title: Some details need fixing
validation.body: Please review the highlighted fields and try again.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this
conflict.body: This record was updated while you were working. Refresh to see the latest version before continuing.

rate_limit.title: Slow down for a moment
rate_limit.body: You're going a little faster than we can keep up with. Try again in a few seconds.

server.title: Something broke on our side
server.body: It's us, not you. We've been notified. Please try again in a moment.

unknown.title: That didn't work
unknown.body: We couldn't complete that and aren't sure why. Our support team can help.

mutation.reverted: We put it back the way it was.

confirm.recoverable: You can restore this from Recently Deleted for 30 days.

fresh.offline: You're offline. Showing the last data we loaded.
fresh.old: This data is getting old. Refresh to see the latest.

conflict.title: This record changed while you were editing
conflict.body: Choose what to keep for each field that was changed in both places. Everything else merges automatically.
conflict.gone: This record was deleted by someone else.

history.title: History
history.empty: No changes recorded for this record yet.
history.emptyHint: Edits, status changes and deletions will appear here.
history.noAccess: Only the account owner can view history.
history.legacyNote: Entries before integrity protection was enabled are not covered.
history.broken: Integrity check failed at entry #{{seq}}. Contact support with reference {{ref}}.

noPermission.title: You don't have access
noPermission.description: Ask your account owner to grant you access to this area.

loadFailed.title: Couldn't load this
loadFailed.description: Something went wrong while loading. Your data is safe.
